summary: Legacy AWS root-role shadowing prevents terraform IAM sync during private deploy
description: Issue summary: During a scheduled private deployment to the prod-us-east account, terraform-runner failed to apply IAM changes. The root cause appears to be a legacy account-level role (root-shadow) that has overlapping trust and a tag-based condition that prevents the expected role-chaining path used by the terraform service. Impact: blocked private-deploy terraform runs for customer-dedicated accounts; prevents scheduled repo-driven rolling updates to Dedicated pools. Immediate business impact: P1 — deployment window missed and capacity scaling tests cannot proceed.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Checkout infra branch 'private-deploy-fix'
2) Run 'make apply' using CI runner configured with role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/terraform-runner
3) Observe terraform plan succeed, then apply fail at iam.Role resource with AccessDenied
4) Inspect assume-role attempt in CloudTrail and STS logs
5) Confirm the legacy root role (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/root-shadow) is listed in the account and has an overlapping trust policy and a tag condition on 'env'
error_logs:
Terraform apply error: Error: Error applying IAM Role (aws_iam_role.example): arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ops-runner: AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/terraform-runner/session is not authorized to perform: iam:PassRole on resource: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ops-runner
CloudTrail (2026-03-12T08:13:22Z): AssumeRoleFailed - Principal: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/terraform-runner - Error: Not authorized to assume role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ops-runner because of TagCondition mismatch referencing 'env=prod' on legacy role root-shadow.
STS request id: 6b9c9f5a-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-abcdef123456
investigation_notes: 03/12 09:00 - Lena: Noticed terraform-runner CI started failing only for prod-us-east private-deploys after last org-wide tag policy change.

03/12 10:15 - Omar: Pulled CloudTrail entries; found multiple AssumeRoleFailed events where role-chaining attempted to go through ops-runner but was blocked because root-shadow's tag-based condition is evaluated by STS during evaluation of the assume-role chain.

03/12 11:40 - Security: Confirmed there is a legacy 'root-shadow' role created during account onboarding (pre-2022) that carries a conditional trust on tag 'env' and a broad PassRole allowance. It appears to unintentionally shadow the intended chain and STS evaluates conditions against the first matching statement in the trust policy ordering.

03/12 13:05 - Infra: Terraform plan references new role bindings that expect terraform-runner -> ops-runner -> deployer chain. The root-shadow role presence results in STS evaluating tag conditions and returning NotAuthorized errors for chains that would otherwise succeed.

03/12 15:30 - Found that recent org-level tag enforcement policy (enforce-env-tag) added at 2026-03-10 tightened tag requirements; root-shadow lacks compliant tags which causes the conditional block to trigger.

03/13 09:20 - Hypothesis: Legacy role's permissive PassRole + conditional trust is being evaluated earlier by STS and is blocking the expected assume-role flow. Workaround: temporarily remove the tag condition or reorder trust statements to ensure intended chain is first, or add the compliant tags to root-shadow.
03/13 11:00 - Tested a repro by creating a shadow-free account replica in staging; terraform-runner succeeded when root-shadow was absent.
comments: Lena Park (2026-03-12): Opening ticket after CI alert. Blocking deployment window for Dedicated capacity. Attaching CloudTrail snippets and terraform logs.
Omar Ruiz (2026-03-12): Assigned to investigate IAM trust ordering and STS behavior. Will coordinate with Security & Account Ops.

Maya Singh - Security (2026-03-13): Confirmed root-shadow was an onboarding artifact. We prefer not to delete roles without approval; recommending tags be added to make it compliant as a short-term step.

Diego Morales - Infra (2026-03-13): Attempted a manual assume-role via console using terraform-runner identity; got identical AssumeRoleFailed. Created a scoped service account in staging to validate workaround.
Omar Ruiz (2026-03-14): Security-approved minimal tag injection planned in a controlled maintenance window. Will coordinate rota and runbook updates.
root_cause: A legacy account-level 'root-shadow' IAM role with a tag-based trust condition and broad iam:PassRole privileges is being evaluated by STS during role chaining. Because it does not have org-required tags, the tag condition fails and STS returns NotAuthorized, effectively shadowing the intended assume-role chain used by terraform-runner.
resolution: Temporary mitigation: Security approved adding the org-mandated 'env=prod' and 'owner=ops-team' tags to the legacy root-shadow role to satisfy the tag condition so terraform-runner can complete role chaining. Longer-term fix: schedule a follow-up to do one of the following (1) remove/decommission root-shadow after validating no dependent principals, (2) restrict PassRole on root-shadow and add explicit condition to avoid interfering with CI chains, or (3) update terraform-runner role-chaining to use an explicit, isolated ops-anchor role that root-shadow cannot shadow.
resolution_notes: 03/14 04:00 - Security: Added tags 'env=prod' and 'owner=ops-team' to root-shadow in account 123456789012 as temporary fix. Verified tag values via AWS Console and AWS CLI.
03/14 04:10 - Infra: Re-ran terraform apply via CI (private-deploy job); apply completed successfully. Confirmed no regression in other accounts.
03/14 05:30 - Post-checks: CloudWatch metrics for STS AssumeRoleFailure returned to baseline. No further AccessDenied errors observed for the targeted resources.

03/14 09:00 - Omar: Opened GH PR to add a permanent remediation plan and playbook: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2147. Also created follow-up ticket INT-357902 to track decommission plan.

Update account onboarding checklist to flag creation of shadow roles and enforce tagging at creation time.
Add automated scan to IAM inventory job that flags roles with PassRole + missing org tags.
Document in runbook the temporary-tagging procedure and required approvals for emergency fixes.
Schedule a cross-team meeting (Infra + Security + Account Ops) to finalize long-term remediation by 2026-03-28.
